text: ＊ｃｍって…　やだ　このまえと　おなじよー

structure.jp: このまえと　おなじよー
structure.en: it's the same as last time!

patterns.name: 〜と同じ
patterns.span: このまえと　おなじ
patterns.explanation: と before おなじ shows what something is the same as. このまえと　おなじ = 'the same as last time'.

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a word picks it up to react to it, like repeating it in surprise. ＊ｃｍって… = '＊ cm, huh...'
